reason: The cited evidence shows that Al addition reduces density in other RHEAs (E2, E3) and that solid solution strengthening can maintain strength (E2), but none of the passages involve the HfMoTaTiZr system or test Al substitution for Ti in it; the claim that properties are maintained at 1000 °C is unsupported by the cited data, which only go to 900 °C or 1200 °C in different alloys.
premises: Substituting Ti with Al reduces alloy density
Solid solution strengthening from Al maintains mechanical properties
Al substitution does not degrade high-temperature strength up to 1000 °C
The HfMoTaTiZr baseline has high density (10.21 g/cm³) and good mechanical properties
